content.comment_body: Hello! After updating [product_name] Soft Comfort to [version_no], I attempted to connect my laptop both directly and through a router to the [product_name] device, but communication issues continue. Please see the attached error message. This discussion was split from '[product_name] Soft Comfort can’t detect the [product_name]'.
Could you provide the IP address and subnet mask of your PC/Laptop? Is the IP address set as static or dynamic? Also, what are the IP address and subnet mask details for the [product_name] device?

Good morning! My laptop’s IP address is 192.168.0.50 and it uses a static address. The subnet mask is 255.255.255.0. The [product_name] device’s IP address is 192.168.0.1 with a subnet mask of 255.255.255.0.

analysis.insight_summary: Communication problems persist between the laptop and [product_name] device after updating to [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no]. Connections were attempted both directly and via a router, but without success, even though both devices are on the same subnet with static IPs. Users are examining network settings, but the main cause and solution remain unclear.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is seeking straightforward, reliable connectivity between [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no] and the [product_name] device within a local network, ideally without needing manual troubleshooting for basic network configurations.
